title: Weighted support of polynomial-projection higher direct images
statement:
Under the all-fields smaller-dimensional induction hypothesis, R^q f_*M for the first-variable projection A^(n+2)_K to A^(n+1)_K has zero geometric pullback whenever q>=2 and n+2<q+trdeg_K kappa(y). M is killed by a positive integer. Use torsion cohomological dimension as in [def-sc-etale-torsion-cd], the strict localization as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] when it occurs, and Krull dimension as in [def-kun-dimension]. The following verbatim Lean statement specifies all universes, hypotheses, scalar structures, sheaves and degrees:

theorem isZero_stalk_polynomialProjection_of_lowerDimension
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (n : ℕ)
    (hIH : ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] (m c : ℕ), m < n + 2 →
      (Spec (.of L)).HasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE c →
      ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of L))
        [LocallyOfFiniteType a] [QuasiCompact a],
        topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (m : WithBot ℕ∞) →
          X.HasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE (m + c))
    (M : Sheaf (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) K))).smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hM : N • 𝟙 M = 0)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    let f : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) K)) ⟶
        Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K)) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.rename
        (Fin.succ : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 2))).toRingHom)
    let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K)))
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
      (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K))),
      ((n + 2 : ℕ) : Cardinal.{u}) < (q : Cardinal.{u}) +
          residueFieldTrdeg b (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)) →
        IsZero ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} s).obj
          (((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).rightDerived q).obj M))

proof.text: Reuse the coordinate isomorphism from AffinePolynomialHigherProjectionSupport and the private point-pullback and affine-line helpers from AffineLineProjectionStalkBound. Use Etale.nonempty_addEquiv_strictLocalization from FieldHigherDirectImageStalk via import all. The case q=2 forces trdeg of the base residue field to be at least n+1. The polynomial generic strict localization is a separably closed field. The explicit finSuccEquiv/uniqueAlgEquiv identifies the strict-local fibre with an affine line over this field, whose torsion dimension is at most one by the existing source curve theorem.

Compare classical rightDerived with derived-category cohomology and Sheaf.H in the strict-henselization stalk formula. Degree-two cohomology of that affine line vanishes. Testing after algebraic closure is conservative over a field and gives the required inverse-image zero sheaf.
For q>2 apply the separately proved compactification and Leray calculation.
